cues: Merocrine: the secretion leaves by exocytosis and the cell stays whole, as in the salivary glands.
Apocrine: the tip of the cell pinches off with the secretion, as in the mammary gland.
Holocrine: the whole cell breaks down and becomes the secretion, as in the sebaceous glands of the skin.
